title: Password Reset
content: Employees can reset a company password through the internal password portal. If the reset fails, contact the IT help desk.

title: Password Change
content: Employees can change their company password through the approved password portal after signing in. Contact IT support if the change fails.

title: Forgotten Password
content: If an employee forgets the company password, use the internal password reset portal. If recovery is unsuccessful, contact the IT help desk.

title: Password Expired
content: If a company password has expired, use the approved password portal to create a new password. Contact IT support if the portal does not work.

title: Password Policy
content: Company passwords must follow the organization's password policy. Use the approved password portal when creating or changing a password.

title: Account Lockout
content: After multiple failed login attempts, an employee account may become locked. Contact the IT help desk to request account unlock assistance.

title: Unlock Company Account
content: Employees whose company accounts are locked should contact the IT help desk for account unlock assistance.

title: Login Failure
content: If company login fails, verify the username and password and check whether the account is locked. Contact IT support if the issue continues.

title: Username Problem
content: If an employee cannot remember or use the company username, contact the IT help desk for account assistance.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
content: Employees should use the approved multi-factor authentication method when prompted. Contact IT support if MFA cannot be completed.

title: MFA Code Not Received
content: If an MFA verification code does not arrive, verify the registered contact method and network connection, then contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: MFA Device Change
content: Employees who replace their MFA device should contact IT support to update or re-register the approved authentication method.

title: WiFi Not Connecting
content: If company WiFi is not connecting, restart WiFi, forget the network, reconnect, and verify the device has the latest network updates.

title: WiFi Disconnecting
content: If company WiFi keeps disconnecting, reconnect to the approved network, restart the device's WiFi connection, and check for network updates.

title: Slow WiFi
content: For slow company WiFi, reconnect to the approved network, restart WiFi, and check whether the device has current network updates.

title: WiFi Network Missing
content: If the company WiFi network is not visible, restart WiFi and the device, then check again. Contact IT support if it remains unavailable.

title: WiFi Authentication
content: If company WiFi authentication fails, verify that the correct company network is selected and contact IT support if authentication still fails.

title: WiFi on New Laptop
content: A new company laptop should connect to the approved WiFi network using the organization's required credentials. Contact IT support if connection fails.

title: VPN Access
content: Employees working remotely must connect through the approved company VPN. If VPN authentication fails, contact IT support.

title: VPN Not Connecting
content: If the company VPN does not connect, verify the internet connection and retry the approved VPN. Contact IT support if authentication or connection continues to fail.

title: VPN Authentication Failure
content: If VPN authentication fails, verify company credentials and use the approved VPN client. Contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: VPN Disconnecting
content: If the company VPN repeatedly disconnects, check the internet connection and restart the approved VPN client. Contact IT support if it continues.

title: Remote Access
content: Employees working remotely should use the approved company VPN for access to internal company resources.

title: VPN Client Installation
content: Use the approved software request process to obtain the company VPN client. Unauthorized VPN software should not be installed.

title: Laptop Hardware Issue
content: For laptop hardware problems, record the device ID and contact the IT help desk for hardware support.

title: Laptop Not Starting
content: If a company laptop does not start, record the device ID and contact the IT help desk for hardware support.

title: Laptop Screen Problem
content: For a damaged or malfunctioning company laptop screen, record the device ID and contact the IT help desk.

title: Laptop Keyboard Problem
content: If the company laptop keyboard is not working correctly, record the device ID and contact the IT help desk for hardware support.

title: Laptop Touchpad Problem
content: If the company laptop touchpad is not working, restart the device if possible and contact IT support if the issue remains.

title: Laptop Battery Problem
content: For company laptop battery or charging problems, record the device ID and contact the IT help desk.

title: Laptop Overheating
content: If a company laptop is overheating, stop intensive use and contact the IT help desk for hardware support.

title: Laptop Broken
content: For a physically damaged company laptop, record the device ID and contact the IT help desk for hardware support.

title: Lost Laptop
content: If a company laptop is lost, immediately contact the IT help desk or security team so the device and account access can be protected.

title: Stolen Laptop
content: If a company laptop is stolen, immediately report it to the IT help desk or security team and provide the device ID if available.

title: Laptop Device ID
content: The device ID should be recorded when reporting company laptop hardware problems so IT support can identify the device.

title: Software Installation
content: Employees should request software installation through the approved software request process. Unauthorized software should not be installed on company devices.

title: Software Request
content: Use the approved software request process when you need a new application on a company device.

title: Unauthorized Software
content: Employees should not install unauthorized software on company devices. Use the approved software request process instead.

title: Application Not Working
content: If an approved company application is not working, restart the application and contact IT support if the issue continues.

title: Application Installation Failure
content: If an approved software installation fails, retry through the approved software request process and contact IT support if necessary.

title: Software Update
content: Keep approved company software updated according to organizational requirements. Contact IT support if an update cannot be installed.

title: Email Problem
content: If company email is not working, check the internet connection, restart the email application, and verify that the account is signed in. If the problem continues, contact IT support.

title: Email Login
content: If you cannot sign in to company email, verify your account credentials and internet connection. Contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: Email Not Sending
content: If company email cannot send messages, check the internet connection, restart the email application, and verify the account is signed in.

title: Email Not Receiving
content: If company email is not receiving messages, check the internet connection and restart the email application. Contact IT support if the issue continues.

title: Email Application Restart
content: Restart the company email application when email is not working, then verify that the account is signed in.

title: Email Account Sign In
content: Verify that the company email account is signed in when troubleshooting email problems.

title: Email Connectivity
content: Check the internet connection first when company email is not working.

title: Email Sync Problem
content: If company email is not synchronizing, check the internet connection, restart the email application, and contact IT support if needed.

title: Email Access Remotely
content: Remote employees should verify their internet connection and company account sign-in when accessing company email.

title: Email Password
content: If company email access fails because of a password issue, use the approved company password reset process or contact IT support.

title: Printer Problem
content: For a company printer problem, verify the device is connected and restart the printer if appropriate. Contact IT support if the issue remains.

title: Printer Not Printing
content: If a company printer is not printing, check its connection and restart it. Contact IT support if printing still fails.

title: Printer Offline
content: If a company printer appears offline, verify the connection and restart the printer. Contact IT support if it remains offline.

title: Printer Paper Jam
content: For a company printer paper jam, follow the printer's approved clearing procedure. Contact IT support if the jam cannot be cleared safely.

title: Printer Setup
content: Use the approved company process to set up a printer. Contact IT support if the device cannot be connected.

title: Scanner Problem
content: For a company scanner problem, verify the device connection and restart it. Contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: Network Cable
content: If a wired company network connection is not working, verify that the network cable is securely connected and contact IT support if needed.

title: Internet Not Working
content: If company internet is not working, check the network connection and reconnect to the approved network. Contact IT support if the issue continues.

title: Network Connection Problem
content: For a company network connection problem, restart the network connection and verify the device is connected to the approved network.

title: Network Slow
content: If the company network is slow, reconnect the device and check whether the problem affects other services. Contact IT support if it continues.

title: Network Access
content: Employees should use approved company network connections to access internal resources. Contact IT support if access is unavailable.

title: Browser Problem
content: If an approved browser is not working correctly, restart it and verify the network connection. Contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: Browser Cache
content: If a company web application behaves unexpectedly, clearing the approved browser cache may help. Contact IT support if the issue remains.

title: Web Application Access
content: If a company web application cannot be accessed, verify the internet connection and account sign-in, then contact IT support if needed.

title: Teams Problem
content: If the company collaboration application is not working, check the internet connection, restart the application, and contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: Video Meeting Problem
content: For company video meeting problems, check the internet connection, microphone, camera, and application sign-in. Contact IT support if necessary.

title: Microphone Problem
content: If the microphone does not work in a company meeting application, verify microphone permissions and device selection, then contact IT support if needed.

title: Camera Problem
content: If the camera does not work in a company meeting application, verify camera permissions and device selection, then contact IT support if needed.

title: Audio Problem
content: If meeting audio is not working, check the selected speaker and microphone devices and restart the meeting application.

title: File Access
content: Employees should use approved company storage and permissions when accessing work files. Contact IT support if authorized files cannot be accessed.

title: Shared Folder Access
content: If an employee cannot access an authorized shared folder, verify account sign-in and contact IT support for permission assistance.

title: File Permission
content: If an employee needs access to a restricted company file, use the approved access-request process or contact IT support.

title: Cloud Storage Access
content: Use the organization's approved cloud storage service with the company account. Contact IT support if access fails.

title: File Sync Problem
content: If approved company files are not synchronizing, check the internet connection and account sign-in, then contact IT support if the problem continues.

title: Data Backup
content: Important company data should be stored using approved company storage and backup procedures rather than unauthorized personal storage.

title: Security Incident
content: Report suspected security incidents immediately through the organization's approved IT or security reporting process.

title: Phishing Email
content: Do not interact with suspicious links or attachments in a suspected phishing email. Report it through the organization's approved security process.

title: Suspicious Link
content: Do not open suspicious links received through company communication channels. Report the message to IT or security using the approved process.

title: Malware Concern
content: If you suspect malware on a company device, disconnect from risky activity if possible and immediately contact IT or security support.

title: Security Password Sharing
content: Never share company passwords with other people. Use the approved password recovery or reset process when assistance is needed.

title: Device Security
content: Company devices should use approved security controls and software. Contact IT support if a required security control is not working.

title: Screen Lock
content: Employees should lock company devices when leaving them unattended to protect company information.

title: USB Device
content: Use only approved USB and removable storage devices with company systems and follow organizational security requirements.

title: Mobile Device Access
content: Use approved company applications and authentication methods when accessing company resources from a mobile device.

title: Remote Work Security
content: Remote employees should use approved company devices, networks, and VPN access when working with company resources.

title: Access Request
content: Requests for access to company systems should follow the approved access-request process and organizational authorization requirements.

title: New Employee IT Access
content: New employees should receive required company accounts and system access through the organization's approved onboarding process.

title: Employee Offboarding Access
content: When an employee leaves the organization, system access should be handled through the approved IT and HR offboarding process.

title: System Maintenance
content: During planned IT maintenance, some company services may be temporarily unavailable. Follow IT notifications and contact support if access remains unavailable.

title: IT Help Desk
content: The IT help desk is the primary support channel for company technology problems that cannot be resolved using approved troubleshooting procedures.

title: Report IT Problem
content: When reporting an IT problem, provide a clear description of the issue and relevant device or account information requested by IT support.

title: Support Ticket
content: Use the organization's approved IT support ticket process to report technical issues and track support requests.

title: Urgent IT Issue
content: For urgent technology or security issues, use the organization's approved urgent IT or security reporting channel immediately.

title: Account Access Request
content: If you need access to a company system, submit an access request through the approved process and provide the required business justification.

title: Employee Device Setup
content: Company devices should be configured using approved organizational setup procedures and required security controls.

title: New Laptop Setup
content: New company laptops should be configured through the approved IT setup process before being used for company work.

title: Device Replacement
content: For a company device that needs replacement, provide the device ID and contact the IT help desk for assistance.

title: Device Return
content: When returning a company device, follow the organization's approved IT asset-return procedure.

title: IT Policy Question
content: Questions about company IT procedures should be answered using the organization's approved IT documentation or by contacting the IT help desk.
